summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Genter Capital International Dividend ETF (GENW) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high dividend yield equity. The fund is an actively managed fund that primarily invests in foreign and domestic, large cap securities, selected and weighted based on a quantitative screening and fundamental analysis. GENW was launched on Dec 31, 2024 and is issued by Genter Capital.

holdings.infoBox: GENW is an equity ETF with a total of 37 individual holdings. The top holdings are Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group stock at 4.67%, ABB Ltd ADR at 4.62%, Barclays at 4.49%, Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria at 4.48%, and Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group at 4.34%.
